title: SAP2022T2T3TOWN22: usually resident population aged 1 year and over by usual residence 1 year before Census Day, by Towns 2022
used_for: U33. A sourced PROXY for the gross household move rate, replacing the unmet internal-consistency criterion on `move_out` in lifecourse/tenyear.py's vital-statistics check. Cobh's own share of residents who were at a different address one year earlier. The person-to-household conversion stays [A] (A-25b): this bounds the hazard, it does not set it. Exposure stays `none` because nothing is fitted to it - the hazard keeps its declared value and this says whether that value is consistent with what the Census observed.
